rows.label: bf02420100_0010
rows.name: I don't think they're following us.

rows.label: bf02420100_0020
rows.name: Looks like we lost them.

rows.label: bf02420100_0030
rows.name:
Let's take a break for now.
I'm at my limit...

rows.label: bf02420100_0040
rows.name: Tora too... huff, huff, mo...

rows.label: bf02420100_0050
rows.name: See you later.

rows.label: bf02420100_0060
rows.name: [ML:undisp ]え？

rows.label: bf02420100_0070
rows.name:
Thank you for everything.
I wish you all a safe journey.

rows.label: bf02420100_0080
rows.name: Well then...

rows.label: bf02420100_0090
rows.name: I want to reach Eden!

rows.label: bf02420100_0100
rows.name: [ML:undisp ]え

rows.label: bf02420100_0110
rows.name:
I made a promise. I'm
taking Homura to Eden.

rows.label: bf02420100_0120
rows.name:
I... want to grant Homura's wish,
after she shared her life with me.

rows.label: bf02420100_0130
rows.name: Rex-

rows.label: bf02420100_0140
rows.name: But there are a lot of people after Homura.

rows.label: bf02420100_0150
rows.name:
With the Divine Beasts dying off,
living space is running out...

rows.label: bf02420100_0160
rows.name:
That leads to conflict. And to win,
people need great power...

rows.label: bf02420100_0170
rows.name: That's why they want her.

rows.label: bf02420100_0180
rows.name: [ML:undisp ][ML:Dash ][ML:Dash ]

rows.label: bf02420100_0190
rows.name:
If Eden's existence can be proven,
maybe conflicts like that will stop.

rows.label: bf02420100_0200
rows.name:
But... I realized something
fighting that guy Meleph just now.

rows.label: bf02420100_0210
rows.name:
I can't protect Homura
with just my own power.

rows.label: bf02420100_0220
rows.name: You're a Driver, right, Nia?

rows.label: bf02420100_0230
rows.name: I'd really like you to lend me your strength.

rows.label: bf02420100_0235
rows.name: Would that be okay?

rows.label: bf02420100_0240
rows.name: Eden? You seriously believe that tall tale?

rows.label: bf02420100_0250
rows.name:
Homura told me Eden is her homeland.
And Homura is right here.

rows.label: bf02420100_0260
rows.name: So it must exist, right?

rows.label: bf02420100_0270
rows.name:
What's with that syllogism?
It's just like Morph's.

rows.label: bf02420100_0275
rows.name:
Honestly, I don't know if you're
short-sighted or just too good-natured...

rows.label: bf02420100_0280
rows.name: But what if Homura's just lying?

rows.label: bf02420100_0290
rows.name:
What if she's only pretending she's headed for Eden,
then one day chomps you from the head down? What then?

rows.label: bf02420100_0300
rows.name: Homura wouldn't do that!

rows.label: bf02420100_0310
rows.name:
I couldn't eat you from the head down.
I'd get a stomachache.

rows.label: bf02420100_0320
rows.name:
You're taking that part seriously?
Pfft... Ahaha... ahahahahaha!

rows.label: bf02420100_0330
rows.name:
An emerald Core Crystal is the sign
of Heaven's Holy Grail... huh.

rows.label: bf02420100_0340
rows.name:
Sure, why not. This
could be interesting.

rows.label: bf02420100_0350
rows.name: Nia.

rows.label: bf02420100_0360
rows.name: My lady!

rows.label: bf02420100_0370
rows.name:
I've started wanting to see Eden
too. It really does exist, right?

rows.label: bf02420100_0380
rows.name: It does!

rows.label: bf02420100_0390
rows.name: A land in the sky, overflowing with greenery...

rows.label: bf02420100_0400
rows.name:
If the legends are
true, even we might...
